data.name: Moneeb
data.gender_notes: Moneeb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is given something, or one who seeks or gives something. The name Moneeb carries the meaning “Giver, Seeker” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Moneeb usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, seeker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the quest for knowledge and understanding.
data.etymology: Moneeb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Seeker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moneeb total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: منيب
in_arabic.meaning: منيب هو الشخص الذي يرجع إلى الله بالتوبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: منيب هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'تاب' والذي يعني الرجوع إلى الله بالتوبة. الشخص المنيب هو الذي يترك الذنوب ويرجع إلى الله تعالى بطاعة ونية صادقة. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق التوبة والرجوع إلى الله.

in_urdu.name: منیب
in_urdu.meaning: منیب وہ شخص ہے جو اللہ کی طرف توبہ کرے
in_urdu.long_meaning: منیب نام کا مطلب ہے جو شخص پاپوں سے توبہ کرکے اللہ کی طرف مڑتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'توبہ کرنا' یا 'اللہ کی طرف رجوع کرنا'۔ اسلامی روایت میں اس نام کا استعمال ایک ایسے شخص کے لیے کیا جاتا ہے جو غلط کاموں سے دور ہو کر اللہ کی عبادت اور اطاعت میں لگ جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुनीब
in_hindi.meaning: मुनीब वह व्यक्ति है जो ईश्वर की ओर प्रपश्च करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुनीब नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति पापों से पश्चाताप करके ईश्वर की ओर मुड़ता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्दों से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'पश्चाताप करना' या 'ईश्वर की ओर लौटना'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए किया जाता है जो गलत कार्यों से दूर होकर ईश्वर की पूजा और आज्ञा में लग जाता है।

in_pashto.name: منیب
in_pashto.meaning: منیب هغه څوک دی چی الله ته راستون شي
in_pashto.long_meaning: منیب نوم معنی دے هغه چا څوک چې د ګناهونو څخه توبه کوي او الله تعالی ته رجوع کوي. دا نوم د عربي لغت څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې دے 'توبه کول' یا 'الله ته راستون کول' . په افغان او پښتون دود کې دغه نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي څوک چې له بدو کارونو څخه ډډه کوي او د الله په عبادت او فرمانبردارۍ پیل کوي.

in_english.name: Moneeb
in_english.meaning: Moneeb means one who turns to God in repentance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Moneeb is derived from the Arabic root 'tawbah,' meaning to turn to God in repentance. This name holds significant spiritual connotations, symbolizing a person's return to righteousness and obedience to God's commands. In Islamic tradition, Moneeb represents an individual who seeks forgiveness and commits to a path of spiritual growth and devotion. Historically, the term has been mentioned in the Quran in the context of sincere repentance and turning back to God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Moneeb holds a significant cultural impact, as it represents the notion of giving and receiving. In Islamic society, the act of giving is considered a virtuous deed and an essential part of one's faith. Giving to those in need, whether it be in the form of time, resources, or kindness, is regarded as a means of attaining spiritual growth and earning the pleasure of God. The name Moneeb can be seen as a reminder to continuously seek opportunities to give and receive, fostering a sense of generosity and compassion within one's community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Moneeb holds deep significance as it is derived from the Arabic roots "mun" meaning, "to give" or "to be given," and "ibn" meaning, "son of." This can be interpreted as a reminder that every individual is a recipient of the infinite blessings and mercy of God. Furthermore, the name emphasizes the importance of being not only a receiver but also a giver – to give of one's time, resources, and kindness to others, reflecting the selflessness and obedience to God's commandments. Through this understanding, the spiritual significance of the name Moneeb underscores the inherent connection between giving and receiving as essential aspects of one's faith and growth in the divine path.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Muneeb: The one who is constantly in God's presence, seeking His guidance and remembrance. The name symbolizes a continual striving towards God, fostering a deep sense of spiritual connection and devotion.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: In the early Islamic period, Moneeb ibn Abi Al-Aas was a well-known poet and companion of the Prophet Muhammad. He was known for his beautiful qasidahs (lengthy odes) and was particularly famous for his poem 'Lamiyyat al-Arab' which he composed during the Farewell Pilgrimage in 632 AD.
historical_references.context: Companion of the Prophet Muhammad and poet famous for his qasidahs, specifically 'Lamiyyat al-Arab'

historical_references.reference: Moneeb ibn Al-Moghira, a renowned scholar and jurist of the Hanbali school of thought, lived during the 13th century. He was born in Damascus and studied under the famous scholar Ibn Taymiyyah. Moneeb is particularly known for his work 'Al-Furqan fi Al-Fiqh' which is a comprehensive text on Islamic jurisprudence.
historical_references.context: Renowned scholar and jurist of the Hanbali school, author of 'Al-Furqan fi Al-Fiqh'
